prompt_text: In the post, the text above the image makes a claim comparing the popularity of Pop and Latin. Identify the according values in the chart to verify this claim. If the claim matches the visualization reply 'correct'. If not, reply 'incorrect'.

answers.profile_name: The profile name shown in this post is The New York Times.
answers.post_claim_correct:
The claim states that Pop was more popular than Latin in 2026. According to the chart, Pop has a preference percentage of 23.5%, while Latin has a preference percentage of 11.0%.

Since 23.5% (Pop) is greater than 11.0% (Latin), the claim is correct.

Therefore, the answer is: correct.
